note: How tall a dropdown's list may be, and whether it earns a search field. Both were decided by hand in each product and differently: the mod wrote popupHeight and showSearch at each of its twenty call sites, with three heights and a judgement per list, while the Manager had one constant and a search field that was always there — so the same list of four answers got a search box in one product and not in the other. A search over a list that fits is furniture; it earns its place exactly when the list is taller than its room.

overflows.out: bool: same question, for a caller whose geometry is settled elsewhere
